rule: For a trusted production monitoring observation, compare the latest genuine F1 score available at its monitoring timestamp with the first genuine F1 score recorded afterward, within the configured future window. Label 1 when the absolute F1 decline is at least the configured threshold; otherwise label 0.
required_observations: A monitoring report from the token-authenticated production ingestion at the prediction timestamp.
A genuine actual-outcome performance evaluation at or before that timestamp.
A later genuine actual-outcome performance evaluation within the future window.
leakage_controls: Monitoring features are computed only from records timestamped at or before the monitoring observation.
Future F1 is used only to create the target and is never included in the feature list.
Only token-authenticated production-source observations are eligible for training labels.
Synthetic, operator-declared-only, or unverified sources are not assigned training labels.
